title: Large Language Models as Nonlinear Dynamical Systems: The Three Clocks of Depth, Training, and Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21983v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models are dynamical systems. A transformer is iterated over its layers, over the steps of its training and over the tokens it generates, and on each of these three clocks it shows behavior that nonlinear dynamics has studied for a century: fixed points, bifurcations, synchronization, chaos and noise-driven escape from potential wells. The two communities rarely meet, so this behavior is often rediscovered under new names. We build a bridge between them. To describe, we condense about 200 papers into the Three-Clock Dictionary, which maps fifteen concepts of nonlinear dynamics onto each clock and marks every correspondence as proved, measured or conjectured, and we show each concept in a mechanical system and in a language model side by side. To explain, we derive reduced-order models: the softmax is a Boltzmann distribution, gradient descent an Euler step on a nonlinear spring, a loss spike a ball thrown out of a stiff valley

translated_title: 大语言模型作为非线性动力系统：深度、训练与生成的三个时钟
translated_abstract: 语言模型是动力系统。Transformer 在其层上迭代、在训练步骤中迭代、在生成的词元序列上迭代，而在这三个“时钟”的每一个上，它都表现出非线性动力学已研究一个世纪的行为：不动点、分岔、同步、混沌以及噪声驱动的势阱逃逸。由于两个学术社区很少交流，这些行为常常以新名称被重新发现。我们在两者之间架起桥梁。为了描述，我们将约200篇论文浓缩为“三时钟词典”，把十五个非线性动力学概念映射到每个时钟上，并将每条对应关系标记为已证明、已测量或推测，同时在机械系统和语言模型中并排展示每个概念。为了解释，我们推导了降阶模型：softmax 是玻尔兹曼分布，梯度下降是非线性弹簧上的欧拉步，损失尖峰则是小球被抛出刚性山谷。
tldr: 本文提出“三时钟”框架，将语言模型在层深度、训练过程和生成过程三个尺度上的行为与非线性动力学的经典概念（不动点、分岔、同步、混沌等）系统对应，并通过汇总约200篇文献的“三时钟词典”和一系列降阶模型在两个学科之间架起桥梁。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "three clocks" framework mapping transformer behavior across layer depth, training, and generation onto classical nonlinear dynamics concepts (fixed points, bifurcations, synchronization, chaos), bridging the two fields through a Three-Clock Dictionary condensing ~200 papers and reduced-order models such as softmax as a Boltzmann distribution and loss spikes as noise-driven escape from potential wells.
